The changes sit in the landing site's JS dependency graph, outside the provider/native-runtime scope (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-011, TB-012). The head text is truncated at line 795 and the patch excerpt is incomplete, so I could not review later lockfile changes: the next node_modules entry (about head lines 1599-1662), the sharp entry (about 3692-3738), or whether the base/head package.json for landing matches the pinned next 16.4.1. The base-side next entry (16.2.6 at lines 3150-3202) is visible but its head replacement is not. I cannot confirm the updated next 16.4.1 lock entry's resolved URL and integrity. The sharp 0.35.x packages are not in the base lock; sharp is an install-script optional dependency (hasInstallScript), which is a normal supply-chain consideration but not a verifiable defect here. Residual question: whether the unseen remainder of the lockfile is consistent with landing/package.json. This is low-risk supply-chain hygiene, not a provider-boundary issue.
